versions.subject: rule: 3proxy usage, fix: rule - missing contains
versions.detection:
selection:
   Image|endswith: '\3proxy.exe'
selection_pe:
   Description: '3proxy - tiny proxy server'
selection_params: # param combos seen in the wild
   CommandLine|contains: '.exe -i127.0.0.1 -p'
condition: 1 of selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\3proxy.exe" OR Description="3proxy - tiny proxy server" OR CommandLine="*.exe -i127.0.0.1 -p*"
